D: Wolverine is sent back to 1973 to stop a choice that dooms mutants in the future.
P: Serve the snacks when Quicksilver races around the Pentagon kitchen in slow motion.
S: Pentagon kitchen tomato soup and toasties
Roasted tomato soup with toasted sandwiches for dunking

Roasted tomato and garlic soup blended smooth with a swirl of cream, in mugs with crisp cheddar toastie fingers for dunking. Halve 1kg tomatoes, toss with 1 quartered onion, 4 garlic cloves and olive oil, and roast at 200C for 30 minutes. Blend with 500ml chicken stock, 1 tsp sugar and salt, then reheat and stir in 50ml cream. Make 4 cheddar toasties from 8 slices of buttered bread and 160g grated cheddar, cooking 3 minutes a side in a frying pan. Cut into fingers and serve with the soup.
Baked choux puffs with gruyere and cracked pepper
Choux pastry with gruyère piped into small balls, baked at 200C for 20 minutes until puffed.
Seventies walnut and cheddar cheese ball

Sharp cheddar, cream cheese and spring onion beaten together, rolled into a ball and coated in toasted walnuts and parsley, with crackers. Beat 250g soft cream cheese with 200g finely grated vintage cheddar, 2 finely sliced spring onions, 1 tsp Worcestershire sauce and a pinch of cayenne. Shape into a ball, wrap in cling film and chill for 2 hours. Toast 80g walnuts in a dry pan, chop finely and mix with 2 tbsp chopped parsley. Roll the ball in the nut mix to coat and serve with crackers.
M: Beef braised in red wine with bacon and mushrooms

Beef bourguignon of chuck, bacon, mushrooms and red wine simmered 3 hours, with buttery mash. Brown 1kg diced beef chuck and 150g bacon. Add 250g mushrooms and cook until golden, then pour in a bottle of red wine. Simmer for 3 hours until tender and glossy. Serve over mash from 1kg potatoes and plenty of butter.
White House lawn burgers and potato salad
the showdown on the White House lawn

Chargrilled beef burgers with cheddar, tomato and pickles in toasted buns, with a creamy mustard and spring onion potato salad. Boil 1kg halved baby potatoes for 15 minutes, drain and cool. Toss with 4 tbsp mayo, 1 tbsp Dijon mustard, 3 sliced spring onions and salt. Shape 600g beef mince into 4 patties and season. Grill over high heat for 4 minutes a side, adding a slice of cheddar for the last minute. Toast 4 buns and fill with lettuce, tomato, pickles, the patties and tomato sauce.
W: Melted dark chocolate and cream for dipping strawberries, marshmallows and sponge
Dark chocolate melted gently with cream in a fondue pot, kept warm at the table, with strawberries, marshmallows and sponge cubes on forks to dip.
K: Tequila, blue curaçao and lime shaken, with a salted rim

Tequila, blue curaçao and fresh lime shaken hard with ice and poured into salt-rimmed glasses, bright blue and sharp. Rub the rims of 4 glasses with lime and dip in salt. For each drink, shake 45ml tequila, 20ml blue curaçao, 25ml fresh lime juice and 10ml sugar syrup hard with ice for 10 seconds. Strain into the glass over fresh ice and garnish with a lime wheel. Make four, using 180ml tequila and 80ml blue curaçao in total.
